job.purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 contract v3 slot cell qkd_kvwq_leaf_s_w129_m (128 instances, slots wleaf_<q>_<pc>): first view under the die master name with the die's own buses c/n/dn/dp/w/wr/lane (the closed route qkd_kvwq_leaf_s_w129_m-b90ad2fab of the same body was exported as cell ot_qkvd_kv_wq_leaf with RTL port names and cannot bind). Body = ot_qkvd_kv_wq_leaf unchanged (every port a flop at its pin); wrapper = wiring only, buses packed LSB first in kv_die BINDINGS order. Outline 129.6 x 183.6, pins M5 (N/S) / M4 (E), clock ck on N, cap M5.

benches.name: kvwq_leaf_slot_exact
benches.note: 60,000 random cycles through the die buses (field offsets generated from kv_die BINDINGS): feed n == c 293 bits exact, take / replace, one push per held word with exact {sec, data, tag}, done on the held tag, bad on any other return, done chain OR; coverage floors on pushes / dones / bads / replaced

benches.name: kvwq_leaf_slot_mutant
benches.note: OT_QKD_KVWQ_LEAF_MUT inverts one CDC write data bit at the pin
